title: A Goodnight to Your Guardian Angel
core_idea: Many people, across traditions, end the day by speaking to a guardian angel; whatever one believes, handing over the day's worries before sleep can bring rest.
text: In many traditions, people are taught as children to say goodnight to their guardian angel. Some keep that habit their whole lives. They lie in the dark and quietly hand over the day: the worry about tomorrow, the conversation that went wrong, the person they're thinking of. Whether you believe an angel is listening, or you simply find comfort in the ritual, there is something kind in it. It's a way of saying, I don't have to hold all of this through the night. Tonight, before sleep, you might try it. Name one thing you're carrying. Then let it rest beside you.
description: A gentle reflection on the old bedtime habit of saying goodnight to a guardian angel, and setting worries down before sleep.
